newsitem.title: UK: MSCI plans Thailand, Indonesia free indices.
newsitem.headline: MSCI plans Thailand, Indonesia free indices.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Capital International said in a statement that its Capital International Persepctive SA is to develop Free Indices for Thailand and Indonesian stock markets.

"The existing MSCI Thailand and MSCI Indonesia indices are calculated using local prices. However, for many securities these prices do not reflect the real conditions prevailing for international investors who must buy on the Foreign Board once the maximum foriegn ownership ceiling has been reached," MSCI said.
The foreign board demands premiums over the local stock.
The MSCI indices are used by fund managers to allocate assets and track performance.
